intro: Use this guide after you've built Receipt-to-Books, to check your submission against the 100-point rubric before a reviewer does. Each row describes what full, partial and low marks look like, so learners and reviewers can score the same evidence the same way. You win at 80 points.

rows.full: The 12-document test report shows expected vs actual route for every document, and at least 11 of 12 match (for example #7, #8 and #9 in Needs_Review with reasons, #10 skipped as not_a_receipt).
rows.partial: 9 or 10 of 12 documents take the expected route, or the report lists routes without showing the reason for each review item.
rows.low: Fewer than 9 documents route correctly, or the 12 tests weren't run and logged.

rows.full: Document #2 (FG-0192 resent) stops at the data store check and is logged; two genuine same-day fuel purchases for the same amount both appear in Expenses; a forwarded copy of one fuel receipt is stopped.
rows.partial: Invoices with numbers are deduplicated, but numberless receipts either merge two real purchases or let a forwarded copy through.
rows.low: No dedupe key or data store check; resent documents are counted twice.

rows.full: Each doubtful item reaches Needs_Review and Tolu's email with a clear reason and source link; after approval, #12 moves into Expenses once (a second Scenario 2 run doesn't add it again); Rejected rows stay out and are logged.
rows.partial: Items reach review, but reasons are vague, or approved rows can be moved twice, or Rejected rows aren't handled.
rows.low: No review tab or no Scenario 2; doubtful items are saved straight to Expenses or lost.

rows.full: For a test month, revenue, cost of goods, gross profit and margin, expenses by category and net profit match a hand calculation; VAT is shown separately; month-on-month change is shown; the email and Monthly_PL row arrive at 07:00 on the 1st (scheduled run in history).
rows.partial: Totals are correct but VAT is mixed in, the comparison with last month is missing, or the run was only triggered by hand.
rows.low: Figures don't match a hand check, the date range is wrong (for example it includes this month), or no report is produced.

rows.full: Every external module (Gmail, Drive, AI, HTTP, Sheets) has a handler; AI and HTTP failures alert and Break with retries; a bad attachment is logged and ignored; an outage test (for example AI provider unreachable) loses no documents and the Errors tab shows it.
rows.partial: Handlers exist on the AI step only, or failures are logged but nobody is alerted, or no outage test was run.
rows.low: No error handlers; a failure stops the scenario silently or loses documents.

rows.full: All three are handled with evidence: numberless receipts have a dedupe key that keeps genuine repeats; a two-invoice PDF becomes two Expenses rows (or goes to review if one is missed); the P&L shows figures ex VAT, VAT separately, and change by amount and %, plus gross margin %.
rows.partial: Two of the three curveballs are handled, or all three are addressed in writing but only partly shown working.
rows.low: One or none of the curveballs is handled.

rows.full: A test report with all 12 documents, credits used and AI cost per document; a monthly estimate at 120 documents with the plan it needs; a 3-minute video ending with the P&L email.
rows.partial: The report or the cost estimate is missing a part (for example no AI cost per document), or the video runs well over or skips the P&L.
rows.low: No report, no estimate or no video.

evidence: Link or screenshots of the books sheet: Expenses, Expense_Lines, Needs_Review, Errors and Monthly_PL, with validation on category and status.
Screenshots of the three scenarios (intake, review, monthly) showing every module and its error handlers.
The 12-document test report: expected vs actual route, reasons for review items, credits used and AI cost per document.
Data store screenshot of stored dedupe keys, plus history showing #2 stopped and two same-day fuel purchases both kept.
The P&L email and Monthly_PL row for a test month, with a hand calculation alongside.
Outage test evidence: the alert email, the Errors row and the documents completing after recovery.
Curveball notes: the dedupe key for numberless receipts, the two-invoice PDF result, and the ex-VAT and month-on-month format.
A 3-minute demo video ending with the P&L email, and the monthly credit estimate with the plan it needs.
mistakes: A dedupe key for receipts that merges two genuine same-day fuel purchases, or one so unique (such as the email ID alone) that a forwarded copy slips through.
AI output saved without arithmetic checks, so a misread digit reaches the books.
A last-month date range that includes this month or misses the 1st, so the P&L totals are wrong.
VAT mixed into costs instead of stored separately, so ex-VAT figures and gross margin are off.
Error handlers on the AI step only; a Sheets or Gmail failure loses a document silently.
Real receipts, bank details or customer data in the test documents or demo video instead of self-made samples.
